results.question: 查询2026年9月的订单量、完单量、完单率

results.name: 多表Join-注册与发单客户
results.question: 查询2025年全年的注册客户数，注册司机数，发单客户数
results.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toYear(create_data_time) = 2025) AS "注册客户数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_driver_all WHERE toYear(create_data_time) = 2025) AS "注册司机数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_large_handcart_order_all WHERE toYear(order_time) = 2025 UNION DISTINCT SELECT customer AS customer_id FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE order_type = 1 AND toYear(toDateTime(ctime)) = 2025 UNION DISTINCT SELECT customer_id FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_valet_order_all WHERE toYear(order_time) = 2025)) AS "发单客户数"
results.answer:
2025年全年，平台新注册客户数为1,032,473人，新注册司机数为280,233人，全年有发单行为的客户数为323,980人。从规模上看，注册客户数明显高于注册司机数和发单客户数，说明全年新增客户基数较大；而发单客户数约占注册客户数的31.4%，意味着新注册客户中约有不到三分之一在当年产生了实际发单行为，客户从注册到发单的转化仍有较大提升空间。

注：本次按注册客户数、注册司机数均以对应表 create_data_time 所在年份统计，发单客户数按大板、小板（order_type=1）、代驾三业务线发单客户去重合并统计的口径计算。

metrics.detail: 缺指标=[] 实际=['注册司机数', '发单客户数', '注册客户数']

results.name: 环比-本月对上月
results.question: 查询本月订单量环比上月
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "本月订单量", SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "上月订单量", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / nullIf(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0), 4) AS "环比增长率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-11-01'

understanding.ambiguity: 环比对象为2026-09-01~2026-09-30；未指定业务线，默认按整体订单量理解

results.answer:
本月订单量为26758笔，上月为134211笔，环比下降约80.06%（即本月仅为上月的19.94%），订单量出现明显回落。这里的环比增长率0.1994表示本月订单量相当于上月的19.94%，并非增长，而是大幅下降。

注：本次按环比对象为2026-09-01~2026-09-30、未指定业务线默认按整体订单量理解的口径/假设计算。

results.name: 复合指标-发单率
results.question: 查询2026年9月的发单率
results.sql:
WITH new_users AS (
    SELECT id AS customer,
           toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_date,
           toDateTime(ctime) AS reg_time
    FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all
    WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01'
),
order_stat AS (
    SELECT o.customer,
           max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 1) AS has_1d,
           max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 3) AS has_3d,
           max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 7) AS has_7d
    FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all AS o
    INNER JOIN new_users AS u ON u.customer = o.customer
    WHERE toDateTime(o.ctime) >= u.reg_time
    GROUP BY o.customer
)
SELECT u.reg_date AS `统计日期`,
       COUNT(*) AS `新注册用户数`,
       SUM(os.has_1d) AS `1天内发单用户数`,
       round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_1d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `1天内发单率`,
       SUM(os.has_3d) AS `3天内发单用户数`,
       round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_3d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `3天内发单率`,
       SUM(os.has_7d) AS `7天内发单用户数`,
       round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_7d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `7天内发单率`
FROM new_users AS u
LEFT JOIN order_stat AS os ON os.customer = u.customer
GROUP BY u.reg_date
ORDER BY u.reg_date
results.answer:
2026年9月新注册客户的首单转化整体在15%上下小幅波动，且随着观察窗口拉长，发单率稳步抬升。以已展示的前8天数据看，1天内发单率在13.7%～16.5%之间，3天内升至14.2%～17.6%，7天内进一步升至14.6%～18.3%，说明用户注册后首单主要集中在当天，但后续几天仍有持续转化。其中9月5日表现最好，1天、3天、7天发单率分别为16.54%、17.61%、18.25%；9月1日相对偏低，分别为13.71%、14.21%、14.58%。这里的“发单率”指注册后N天内产生至少一单的注册客户数占当期注册客户总数的比例，例如1天内发单率14%即每100个新注册客户中约有14人在注册当天完成首单。由于结果仅展示前8行，以上趋势判断仅基于这8天数据。

注：本次按“发单率=注册后N日内产生至少一单的注册客户数/注册客户总数（N=1/3/7），且排除注册前订单”的口径计算。
